integrity: Proof includes scalar-extension descent and signed-doubling orbit classification; finite unrestricted matrix-rank and direct Leibniz checks documented in checker.py and verification_output.txt; finite tests do not prove the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Only odd quandle order and coefficient characteristic coprime to order; no results for even order or characteristic dividing order. The 2026 Fourier source was inspectable only at abstract level; historical priority is not independently confirmed.
title: Arithmetic classification of derivations of odd dihedral quandle algebras
